# Install `marketing-chrome` — Marketing Chrome

> Config-driven marketing site header + footer — the chrome every template hand-rolls. MarketingHeader (split / centered / minimal layouts, Sheet mobile menu) + MarketingFooter (columns / slim). Pure UI, prop-only.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/marketing-chrome
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=marketing-chrome
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/marketing-chrome

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add marketing-chrome
# alias: npx rr add marketing-chrome
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `header`, `footer`, `navbar`, `marketing`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add marketing-chrome`. `<MarketingHeader brand nav cta secondaryCta layout sticky />` — `brand` + `nav` required. `layout`: `split` (brand/nav/cta), `centered` (stacked brand over nav), `minimal` (brand + cta). Mobile collapses into a Sheet. `<MarketingFooter brand columns social legal copyright layout />` — `layout` is `columns` (link grid + legal bar) or `slim` (single row). `nav` items + `social.kind` (github/x/linkedin/youtube/instagram) map to lucide icons. All hrefs render as plain `<a>` — swap to next/link post-copy if you want client routing.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
